rows.label: qst630502_msg0001
rows.name:
Lately, even the Liberalitas
Archipelago has not been peaceful.

rows.label: qst630502_msg0002
rows.name:
A vicious monster called Sea Weiss has
settled on Merukuribe Islet.

rows.label: qst630502_msg0003
rows.name:
You look strong, so I want to ask you
to defeat it.

rows.label: qst630502_msg0101
rows.name:
You made it back safely... Looks like
you defeated it.

rows.label: qst630502_msg0102
rows.name:
What? There were four of them in
total?

rows.label: qst630502_msg0103
rows.name:
No wonder the witnesses' accounts did
not match.

rows.label: qst630502_msg0104
rows.name:
One Driver said it was a beast-like
monster, while a ship captain said it
was bird-like.

rows.label: qst630502_msg0105
rows.name: I never imagined that was the reason.

rows.label: qst630502_msg0106
rows.name:
B-but defeating four vicious monsters
like that is impressive.

rows.label: qst630502_msg0107
rows.name:
Now the Divine Beast ships should be
able to sail safely.

rows.label: qst630502_msg0108
rows.name:
You are without a doubt Alst's
strongest Driver and Blades.

rows.label: qst630502_msg0109
rows.name:
If another big job comes up, I'll send
it your way.

rows.label: qst630502_msg0110
rows.name: Take it if you are willing.

rows.label: qst630502_msg0111
rows.name:
Right, and as promised, I've prepared
a generous reward. Take it.
